title: VHD v1.1.2: Metadata, Human-Adjudicated Labels, Folds, Provenance Notices, and Evaluation Code
description: Non-media reproducibility archive for the VHD diagnostic VideoQA dataset. Contains 801 frozen question records, adjudicated labels, anonymous source-group folds over 341 source clips, per-file provenance notices, deterministic frame/control manifests, checksums, a dataset card, and standalone scoring code. Video files are excluded pending creator confirmation for 42 derivatives from two Internet Archive items.
